family_reports.body: Denied motion and ignored evidence!! None of them did their job they made up…
This system has lied and tore my family apart causing emotional damage
My lived experience that is still ongoing has cast me into homelessness, taken all…
I want people to understand that this was never just a custody case to…
They took the happiest and joy out of us

public_comments.comment_text: Denied motion and ignored evidence!! None of them did their job they made up everything. The judge didn’t want to listen to us whatsoever that we gave him evidence and they didn’t show him any evidence and that he ruled with them over us. He delayed hearings gave them more time biased, he didn’t sign half of his records he had to click record sign it things like that you can put well. She really really wasn’t on our case…

public_comments.comment_text: Mr kirk made no reasonable efforts to put my daughter back in my care, despite having long term housing and employment. He filed no motions with the court on my daughter's behalf. Never came to my house for a visit and I called his office early in the case to setup a home visit and he said that he doesn't complete home visits till after the adjudication and deposition. He is now taking Judge Greers position as the juvenile judge.
